# CWE-798: Artifactory password / API key — hardcoded secret.
# A value matching AP6... is an Artifactory token; committed secrets
# leak to every clone. The rule flags that pattern; fix by using vaults
# or env vars, not literals. ok lines are short or placeholders.
# ruleid: detected-artifactory-password
artifactory_password = AP6abc1231321AbCdEf
# ruleid: detected-artifactory-password
token = AP9ZxYwVuTsRqPoNm
# ok: detected-artifactory-password
integrity sha512-abcdef1234567890==
# ok: detected-artifactory-password
password = "changeme"
# ruleid: detected-artifactory-password
artifactory_token = AP7AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrSt
# ruleid: detected-artifactory-password
secret = AP8ZxYwVuTsRqPoNmLkJiHg
# ok: detected-artifactory-password
password = "changeme_placeholder_example"
